title: AI Search & SEO Audit
summary: A solid technical foundation, with the biggest wins available in AI-search readiness and structured data.

sections.title: AI Search Readiness
findings: No llms.txt found, so AI assistants have no curated entry point to your best content.
Core content renders server-side, so crawlers can read it without running JavaScript.
Author bylines are missing on 6 of 9 key pages, which weakens citability.

sections.title: Technical SEO
findings: Clean, crawlable HTML with a valid sitemap.xml and robots.txt.
Core Web Vitals pass on mobile and desktop.
Two pages return soft 404s and should be fixed or redirected.

sections.title: Content & E-E-A-T
findings: Topic coverage is strong, but few pages cite sources or named data.
No visible last-updated dates, which AI engines read as a freshness signal.
Adding first-hand experience and named authors would lift trust signals.

sections.title: Structured Data
findings: Organization and WebSite schema are present and valid.
Article and FAQ schema are missing on pages that would benefit from them.
No Product or LocalBusiness markup where it applies.

actions: Publish an llms.txt that points AI assistants at your best pages.
Add named author bylines and visible last-updated dates to key pages.
Add Article and FAQ schema where the content supports it.
Cite named data and sources to improve citability.
